# Tokenization consumer starter

Dependency-only entry point for the remote consumer. Configure `axiz.tokenization.mode` explicitly;
select the HTTP-client capability and the application's servlet or reactive stack. See the
[autoconfiguration guide](axiz-tokenization-spring-boot-autoconfigure.md) for authentication,
timeouts, lifecycle, uncertainty and usage. This starter does not select a server, database or keys.

## Selection

Versions are managed by `axiz-bom`; applications inherit `axiz-parent-service`.

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-tokenization-spring-boot-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

This artifact composes dependencies; its wiring and operational contract are documented in
[`axiz-tokenization-spring-boot-autoconfigure`](axiz-tokenization-spring-boot-autoconfigure.md).

## Catalog usage

```bash
axiz add tokenization
```

Required capabilities: `http-client`, `security`.

The catalog supplies the following properties. Environment placeholders must resolve in the
service configuration; they are not credentials or provisioned infrastructure.

```yaml
axiz.tokenization.mode: remote
axiz.tokenization.remote.client: token-vault
axiz.http-client.clients.token-vault.base-url: ${TOKEN_VAULT_URL}
axiz.http-client.clients.token-vault.auth.type: TOKEN_RELAY
axiz.http-client.clients.token-vault.retry: NONE
axiz.http-client.clients.token-vault.max-attempts: 1
axiz.http-client.clients.token-vault.max-concurrent-calls: 32
axiz.http-client.clients.token-vault.max-connections: 32
axiz.http-client.clients.token-vault.connect-timeout: 2s
axiz.http-client.clients.token-vault.read-timeout: 5s
axiz.http-client.clients.token-vault.total-timeout: 10s
```

See [tokenization](../../guias/tokenizacion.md) for client/vault boundaries,
profiles, authorization, retention and the independent field-protection flow.
